description: Shell script for testing 'git fetch --set-upstream' and 'git pull --set-upstream' commands, including setup, configuration checks, and various test cases.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Checks if a branch's remote and merge config are set correctly.

methods.name: check_config_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a branch's remote and merge config are missing.

methods.name: clear_config
methods.description: Unsets remote and merge configurations for given branches.

methods.name: ensure_fresh_upstream
methods.description: Creates a fresh bare repository named 'parent'.
